posts.text: Zettaone’s acquisition by Jubilant Ingrevia looks quite interesting. Jubilant is acquiring a 40% stake for ₹189.2 Cr, implying a valuation of around ₹473 Cr. Zettaone reported revenue of ₹98.1 Cr in FY26, ₹79.1 Cr in FY25 and ₹51.1 Cr in FY24, indicating good growth over the last three years. At nearly 4.8x FY26 revenue, Jubilant appears to be valuing Zettaone not just on current earnings but on its capabilities in electronics design, semiconductor-related engineering and manufacturing. posts.text: Summary of 2027Q1 Conference Call. Jubilant Ingrevia Limited reported a strong start to FY27, achieving a 15-quarter high in revenue and significant growth across all business segments despite geopolitical uncertainties in the Middle East. Financial Performance Highlights Revenue: Reached ₹1,300 crore, representing a 25% year-on-year (YoY) increase. EBITDA: Grew by 36% YoY to ₹209 crore, with margins benefiting from improved pricing and a richer product mix. Profit After Tax (PAT): Increased by 41% YoY to ₹106 crore.
